Metadata.Goal: 以 Property-first Kon、双时间关系事实和唯一调整写者实现可执行的组织管理与组织调整 DomainContext bundle。
Metadata.Description: 新增独立组织域 bundle、确定性时间历史、完整 operation/preset/probe matrix、状态机与原子/best-effort 事务证据，并补齐 runtime 的可信 handler 结构化诊断边界；production server/UI 接入留给 mission G4。

TaskSpace.name: add-temporal-organization-context-bundle
TaskSpace.Description: 先冻结 Property-first catalog/seed，再实现 temporal projections、adjustment workflow 与 batch/rollback convergence。

TaskGroup.name: Model Catalog And Seed
TaskGroup.Description: 用 RED tests 冻结八实体、typed Property relations、temporal bounds、资源/operation catalog、完整 presets 与 deterministic boundary seed。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: 组织 bundle 通过 public loader 且 deep-frozen，不含 server/current/execution state
所有关联只由 Property NamedConf 拥有，Field 仅含物理 metadata
每个 operation 有 exact timeline-aware preset 和 binding/probe

Task.name: Write model catalog and seed RED tests
Task.Description: 断言公开 export、八实体、Property relation map、双时间字段、资源/definition 维度、timeline declarations、preset parity、seed workflow states 和 package boundary；实现前验红。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: RED tests 覆盖八实体、Property-first relation 和 valid/recorded bounds
RED tests 覆盖至少十个 operation refs、完整 presets、bindings/probes 与 frozen/no-state authority
planning baseline 的 39 个 bundle tests 保持通过

Task.name: Implement Property-first model catalog and deterministic seed
Task.Description: 新增独立 organization module，建立八实体 Kon model、resources、definitions、complete requests、DRAFT/VALIDATED/APPROVED/APPLIED/invalid seed 与 plain exports，不接 production registration。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 公共 compiler 产生正确字段、主键和 navigation relation tuple，无旧 ORM DSL residue
bundle load/freeze、catalog/preset parity 与 deterministic seed tests 全绿
root index 只 re-export 新 module，现有两个 reference registration 行为不变

TaskGroup.name: Temporal Projections
TaskGroup.Description: 实现 snapshot/history/compare 与同源 pure preview/validation，证明时间边界和零写 authority。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: 2025-06-30 与 2025-07-01 snapshot tree 差异准确且确定
history/compare 只从 temporal facts 派生并支持 current/recorded slice
Preview/Validate 共用 validator 且 Writer 调用为零

Task.name: Write temporal projection and validator RED tests
Task.Description: 执行 exact presets，断言 boundary snapshots、ordered history、deterministic compare、recorded slice、preview projected changes、cycle/missing/interval-overlap/primary-assignment codes 与零 mutation/Writer。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: snapshot/history/compare 各有真实 relational execution case
valid lower inclusive、upper exclusive、null infinity 与 recorded slice 有边界证据
preview/validate 结果同源且 effect/evidence 均为 zero write

Task.name: Implement temporal readers projectors and pure validator
Task.Description: 用 closed RuntimeQuery predicates 读取 current/recorded facts，组装 deterministic tree/table/composite outcomes，并以纯函数分别校验状态、目标、cycle、temporal interval overlap、Person primary-assignment uniqueness 和 sequence。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 所有 read-only handlers 通过 public context.read 且不导入 storage/private API
snapshot/history/compare 输出与 seed 边界精确一致
validator 返回 stable structured facts，被 Preview/Validate 和后续 Apply 复用
完整 current-recorded timeline 拒绝非法 valid/recorded bounds、dangling identity reference 与 future constraint drift

TaskGroup.name: Adjustment Workflow And Writer
TaskGroup.Description: 建立唯一 effect owner，完成 MarkValidated/Approve/Apply 的状态机、revalidation、temporal replacement、audit 与原子回滚。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: production module 中只有私有 OrganizationAdjustmentWriter 调用 context.write
MarkValidated 在同一 atomic execution 内 validate-then-transition；合法状态依序推进，非法/重复状态 fail closed
Apply 同事务提交 facts/event/status，post-replacement failure 全回滚

Task.name: Write workflow apply and rollback RED tests
Task.Description: 覆盖 MarkValidated validate-then-transition、approve/apply success、DRAFT/APPLIED/cycle/missing/interval-overlap/primary-assignment failure、context.recordedAt replacement、event/status、source unique-writer guard 和 after-first-replacement rollback。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 状态机 success/failure、MarkValidated validation failure、TEMPORAL_INTERVAL_OVERLAP 与 MULTIPLE_PRIMARY_ASSIGNMENTS cases 独立覆盖
apply success mutation/probe/diff 同时证明 temporal facts、audit 和 APPLIED status
故障注入后 committed none、mutation facts empty、after equals before

Task.name: Implement private adjustment writer and workflow handlers
Task.Description: 实现唯一 writer、full-row state updates、non-delete temporal replacements、same recordedAt audit append、MarkValidated 同执行 validation 与 Apply transaction-time 双不变量 revalidation，以及 handler registry wiring。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: source guard 证明只有 writer 持有 context.write，validator/projector 无 write port
replacement 关闭 recordedTo 并插入 current rows，所有写使用同一 execution recordedAt
workflow/apply/rollback focused tests 全绿
create/close 维护完整 temporal relations，约束失败保留 stable code/path

TaskGroup.name: Batch Freshness And Convergence
TaskGroup.Description: 实现独立 batch adjustment，运行 package regression/build/boundary，并以 fresh review 和独立 verify 收口。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: atomic invalid batch 全回滚，best-effort partial 仅提交 valid sibling 并映射失败 item
sequential/concurrent write executions 从等价 seed 开始且无 module-global state
bundle tests/build/import guard/Codument/XML/diff 与 fresh AttractorCheck 全 PASS

Task.name: Implement and verify independent transfer batch
Task.Description: 为每个 Person item 建 adjustment/item/audit，并覆盖 atomic success/rollback、best-effort partial、stable mapping 和 fresh sequential/concurrent execution。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: atomic 与 best-effort batch outcome/commit/mapping 符合统一 runtime semantics
成功 item 有真实 adjustment/item/temporal/audit evidence，失败 item 无残留
连续和并发执行 deterministic 且 execution ids 独立
batch adjustment 不跳过 workflow 边，且 atomicity 不改变同一 items 的业务有效性
每个 batch item 在 Writer 前复用完整 current-recorded candidate-state validator

Task.name: Run package regression boundary and track convergence
Task.Description: 运行完整 bundle tests/build/import guards、old-reference compatibility、Codument strict/XNL/XML/diff、behavior matrix audit、fresh AttractorCheck 与独立 verify，修复 completion-critical gaps。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 所有新增/既有 bundle tests 和 package build 通过，失败数为零
无 server/capsule/private import、无旧 ORM DSL、无 module-global execution state
fresh AttractorCheck 和 independent verify 均 PASS，track evidence 可归档

cdt:AttractorCheck.note: Fresh reviewer found no remaining direction or temporal integrity gap; focused 45/45, bundle build, scoped Codument/decision validation, and diff check pass. Report: analysis/attractor-check-final-005.md.
